review.tagline: Dependency-aware issue tracker CLI that gives coding agents persistent task memory
review.summary: bd (Beads) is a Go CLI that stores tasks as a dependency graph in a Dolt database, replacing markdown TODO lists for coding agents. Agents use commands such as bd ready, bd update --claim and bd close, with JSON output and hash-based IDs to avoid merge collisions. bd setup installs hooks and instructions for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others; sync runs through Dolt remotes on a git remote.
review.audience: Developers running coding agents who need persistent, multi-agent task tracking
strengths: Hash-based IDs (bd-a1b2) avoid merge collisions across agents and branches
Embedded Dolt mode needs no separate database server
bd setup installs integrations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Factory and more
Works without git via BEADS_DIR and --stealth, including non-git VCS
weaknesses: Embedded mode is single-writer; concurrent writers need an external dolt sql-server
HTTP backend is marked experimental and diverges from local behavior in documented ways
Upgrades across schema migrations need a designated clone to migrate and push
issues.jsonl is only an export, not a backup; sync relies on Dolt remotes
needs: Needs Dolt (embedded by default; external dolt sql-server for server mode), git remote (optional, for sync)
